method.workload: Same as profile.js: decode gallery images/fonts, three RAF callbacks; 30 baseline frames; all 12 first opens; 12 next-card changes over 180 warmed animation frames; 180 scroll frames when vertical overflow exceeds 80px; wrap and live-name persistence checks. No artificial artwork animation.
method.accounting: Passive network events during timing; response sizes, body reads, response hashes, and local file hashes after the timed workload. Cold scope is every HTTP request initiated by galleryReady. Workload scope ends after the functional checks. No repeat-load cache experiment.
method.caveats: Fresh contexts do not isolate the machine, GPU, OS caches, or browser process. No CPU/network throttling. Mobile is a layout viewport, not a physical phone. Windows Playwright WebKit is not Safari on a Mac. RAF intervals are not display FPS; two-frame open latency is not INP.

network.definition: Cold includes the navigation and every HTTP(S) resource request begun by galleryReady; workload includes every resource request begun by the final workload boundary. Completed response sizes are retrieved after timing. Encoded bodies exclude headers; transferBytes is Resource Timing response accounting where supported, not packet-level network traffic. Resource requests may include cache hits; only explicit deliveryType=cache is labelled cached. A zero unsupported transfer size remains unavailable. Embedded data/blob assets are already inside their containing response and do not create requests.
